subject: scope polish coverage check to narrative-owned claims
summary: Two fixes in src/pipeline/server.py. (1) The post-polish coverage check in _write_all_exports now covers only claims the pre-polish narrative accounted for itself, by content or a [verify] line. Claims covered only by placed transcript are exempt, so a paraphrased placed claim no longer causes a spurious rejection. The narration restore, which reverts a polished step narration that drops a claim the original covered, guards those placed claims. The narrative-revert test, test_polish_rejected_when_it_drops_claim_coverage, passes. (2) In photo mode, the sidecar no longer lists polish-dropped verify claims whose text is rendered verbatim in a step narration. Polish still runs there, because test_photo_build_unstructured_transcript_gets_semantic_placement needs the polished text. Not verified: the final gate. ruff check and ruff format passed. A full pytest run reached 643 passed, 5 skipped, then failed on tests/test_recorder.py::test_scripted_session_produces_ordered_manifest_and_screenshots. That test passes when run alone, so it looks flaky. A full rerun printed only a pystray teardown traceback with no pass/fail summary, and my next rerun was denied by the permission mode, so I couldn't confirm a clean run. The mojibake in tests/test_recorder.py and the uncommitted .audit/fix/build.schema.json change were not touched. The coverage-drop regression is addressed only for the narrative revert and the narration restore path; I did not add new tests for the paraphrased-placed-claim case.
